---
title: "Office hours"
pagetitle: "Office hours — Mads Fuglsang Hove"
---

Book a **15-minute slot** below. Pick a time that is free, enter your name and email, and
you will get a confirmation with a calendar invite. Once a slot is taken it disappears for
everyone else, so there is no risk of two of you turning up at once.

::: {.note-box}
**Before you book**, it helps a great deal if you write one or two sentences in the notes
field about what you want to discuss — a thesis idea, feedback on a draft, a methods
problem, or a course question. Fifteen minutes goes quickly.

**Need longer?** Book two consecutive slots, or [email me](mailto:madshove@ps.au.dk).
:::

## Where

Office hours are held in **building 1340, room 135**, Department of Political Science,
Aarhus University — or online, if you pick the online option when booking.

## Practical notes

- Slots open roughly two weeks ahead and close one hour before the start time.
- If you cannot make it, cancel through the link in your confirmation email so the slot
  frees up for someone else.
- Outside term time and during leave, availability is limited — the calendar will simply
  show no open slots.
